Example data set

Source: R/example.R
hybridclock_example.Rd

Simulates a small data set: 20 animals from each of two pure reference groups and two hybrid sites. Site A is a young hybrid swarm (4 generations, no arrivals); site B has been backcrossing into species 1 for 15 generations. Animals carry 300 diagnostic SNPs, 40 SNPs that are not quite fixed, and 150 shared SNPs, on 490 separate loci. The data are simulated afresh with a fixed seed, so every call returns the same data.

Usage

hybridclock_example()

Value

A list with genotypes (animals x SNPs, counts of the reference allele), groups ("species1", "species2", "site_A", "site_B"), locus (locus of each SNP) and truth (the simulated histories of the two sites at the time of sampling).

Examples

ex <- hybridclock_example()
table(ex$groups)
#> 
#>   site_A   site_B species1 species2 
#>       30       30       20       20 
ex$truth
#>      site generation hybrid_age_both hybrid_age_rare backcrosses arrival_rate
#> 4  site_A          4        3.641667        3.754127   0.5416667            0
#> 15 site_B         15        9.592318       14.787010   2.7037638            0
